recurringPatterns.pattern: Concessive-negation sentence with 'by itself'/'alone' as the default unit of analysis, hundreds of times
instances: It does not by itself establish the exact interval between injury and death...
Neither term by itself establishes the specific intent required for a legal finding of genocide

recurringPatterns.pattern: Stock pivot phrases ('That distinction matters', 'The important change') opening the third paragraph of a case
instances: That distinction matters. A physical injury, considered alone, tells us that force damaged a body.
The important change lies in the relationship among record, container, and allocation.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Case sections welded without breaks: conclusion then 'At [place], [date],' mid-paragraph
instances: ...while motive and organization remain questions rather than answers. At Ofnet Cave in Bavaria...
...institutions that could make it recur. At Varna, on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical paired-abstraction closers ('Protection and hierarchy were joined within the same arrangement')
instances: Protection and hierarchy were joined within the same arrangement.
Protection and extraction were connected parts of the same imperial arrangement.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapter-terminal recap loops re-describing every case in order, then a numbered protocol or forward question
instances: The strongest interpretation begins by naming the evidence before naming the event. At Talheim...
Taken together, these cases distinguish capacity from incentive, justification, and consequence.

summary: Methodologically serious survey; failure is structural: ~90 case studies machined to one five-move template; relentless negation costs it its argument; repeats sites and recap passages; authoritative, readable, inert.
